canari_commit.message:
feat(checkpoint): emit c2sp.org signed notes so an existing witness can co-sign us

Competitive finding that forced this, stated plainly: `alexar76/histor` already
implements RFC 9162 Merkle and, more importantly, c2sp.org/tlog-checkpoint +
signed-note + tlog-cosignature, and pushes its checkpoint to real witnesses
(witness.stagemole.eu, markovianprotocol.com/witness, gdbsecurity.com, the
Google TrustFabric staging witness). I ran our 144 proof vectors through their
`histor/merkle.py`: 72/72 inclusion and 72/72 consistency pass. So the Merkle
algorithm is not and was never a moat.

What we did have was a vendor-specific head format, which is actively worse than
nothing for a transparency log: a witness network cannot co-sign bytes it does
not understand. So the same head is now also emitted in the standard form.

canari/checkpoint.py implements, byte-exactly:
  checkpoint text = <origin>\n<size>\n<base64 root>\n
  key id          = SHA-256(name || 0x0A || type || pubkey)[:4]
  signature line  = "\u2014 " name " " base64(keyid || sig) "\n"
  log key         = type 0x01, Ed25519 over the note text
  cosignature/v1  = type 0x04 over "cosignature/v1\ntime <unix>\n" || text,
                    signature bytes = 8-byte BE time || 64-byte Ed25519
  non-canonical base64, leading-zero sizes and short roots are refused

Conformance is pinned against another project's published Go-generated vectors
(alexar76/histor test-vectors, Apache-2.0), not our own output:
  - their checkpoint text round-trips through our encoder byte-for-byte
  - their log signature verifies under our verifier
  - their witness cosignature yields timestamp 1761800000
  - a cosignature over different text is rejected

Also fixed: CryptoSigner.sign() returns a *hex string*, not bytes. Shipping it
raw produced

lines: These vectors come from `alexar76/histor`'s published test-vectors
(`test-vectors/vectors.json`, Apache-2.0). They are generated by that project's
Go reference implementation, so passing them is evidence that our bytes match
